name: smartdiagram
description: SmartDiagram AI — 用自然语言生成专业图表

scripts.dev:backend: cd apps/api-diagram && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload
scripts.dev:ppt-api: bash scripts/run-with-root-env.sh bash -c 'cd apps/api-ppt && PYTHONPATH=src uv run uvicorn ppt_agent_api.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4000 --reload'
scripts.dev:ppt-renderer: bash scripts/run-with-root-env.sh bash -c 'cd apps/service-ppt-renderer && API_PORT=4010 API_HOST=127.0.0.1 pnpm dev'
scripts.test:typescript: corepack pnpm --filter @ppt-agent/slide-ir test && corepack pnpm --filter @ppt-agent/slide-ir build && corepack pnpm --filter @ppt-agent/shared exec tsx --test 'src/**/*.test.ts' && corepack pnpm --filter @ppt-agent/shared build && corepack pnpm --filter @ppt-agent/agents exec tsx --test 'src/**/*.test.ts' && corepack pnpm --filter @ppt-agent/ppt-renderer exec tsx --test 'src/**/*.test.ts' && corepack pnpm --filter @ppt-agent/api exec tsx --test 'src/**/*.test.ts' && corepack pnpm --filter @smartdiagram/web exec tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.app.json --test 'src/**/*.test.ts' 'src/**/*.test.tsx'
scripts.test:python: cd apps/api-diagram && uv run python -m pytest tests -q && cd ../api-ppt && uv run python -m pytest tests -q
scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d db redis drawio
scripts.db:down: docker compose stop db redis drawio
scripts.db:generate: corepack pnpm exec prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:migrate:diagram: cd apps/api-diagram && uv run python scripts/migrate_database.py
scripts.db:prepare: docker compose run --rm --no-deps ppt-db-init && pnpm run db:generate && pnpm run db:migrate:diagram && pnpm run db:migrate:ppt
scripts.smoke:enterprise: cd apps/api-diagram && DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://postgres:smartdiagram_secret@localhost:5432/smartdiagram uv run python scripts/smoke_enterprise_flow.py --require-db
scripts.smoke:knowledge: cd apps/api-diagram && DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://postgres:smartdiagram_secret@localhost:5432/smartdiagram uv run python scripts/smoke_knowledge_permissions.py --require-db
scripts.smoke:runtime: cd apps/api-diagram && uv run python scripts/smoke_runtime_guards.py
scripts.smoke:office: cd apps/api-diagram && uv run python scripts/smoke_office_artifacts.py
scripts.smoke:recruit: cd apps/api-diagram && uv run python scripts/smoke_recruit_screening.py
scripts.smoke:budget: cd apps/api-diagram && DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://postgres:smartdiagram_secret@localhost:5432/smartdiagram uv run python scripts/smoke_tenant_budget.py --require-db
scripts.smoke:ops: cd apps/api-diagram && DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://postgres:smartdiagram_secret@localhost:5432/smartdiagram uv run python scripts/smoke_ops_metrics.py --require-db
